subject: general
question:
Study the given graph and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f5f098157c32e144ef1716f08d1cfcc75280332358759e608f014ac1a4a20ed.png] 

In which month is the actual production of ACs is 66% more than the target production?
solution:
Calculation: 

Percentage more of the actual production of ACs than the target production for January = {(70 - 60) over 60} times 100\% ≈ 16.67%

Percentage more of the actual production of ACs than the target production for February = {(50 - 30) over 30} times 100\% ≈ 66%

Since Option 2 already has February and February is a valid answer to this question, there is no need to check any further.

**∴ In February the actual production of ACs is 66% more than the target production.**
